title: ETA worsens while the agent is composing its reply
description: The narrowest mid-turn window the spec describes: the action is already decided and the model is mid-sentence when the backend reports the delay has crossed into a higher band. The committed reply still goes out - the agent does not retract something it has already decided to say - and the new reality is then evaluated on top of it, which escalates. Complements SCN_08, where the event lands during a tool call rather than during generation.

expect.note: The delay crosses the top band mid-turn. R5 escalates immediately and must not offer reassignment, so whatever the agent was about to say about a driver is superseded by a handover.
